products.name: Vidu (Tsinghua / Shengshu)
products.note: Video generation model; academic spin-off; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
Shengshu Technology operates Vidu, an AI video generation platform accessible at vidu.studio. The company describes Vidu as a tool that transforms text prompts, images, and reference videos into high-quality video output, supporting three primary creation modes: Text to Video, Image to Video, and Reference to Video. The platform is positioned for independent creators, teams, and businesses, with stated use cases spanning social media content, 2D animation, commercial advertising, and product image animation.

Vidu's feature set includes an AI sound effect generator, an AI image generator, and specialized tools such as an AI animation generator, AI video ad generator, AI hug generator, and AI kissing generator, alongside a template library. The company describes a model called Story Grid as a first-of-its-kind release and emphasizes fine detail handling as a differentiator from competing models.

The site's reference to Tsinghua University reflects Vidu's origin as an academic spin-off, a detail noted in the held facts alongside an advisory that cross-border data review is recommended for users. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
